title: 109 · Onde Fica app film
provenance: Dedicated independent Canvas reconstruction of the full 59.5-second vertical Onde Fica film: traced arrow, orange occasion typography, Curitiba grid and point map, user glyph-particle and satisfaction ring, isometric room carousel and authored fragment assembly, phone wish-list and detailed profile, map/list/route gallery, evolving badges, curator podium, user lists and closing brand flight. All phone UI is authored code. Four isolated room illustrations, fifteen isolated badge metal variants and four isolated food/interior photo textures and one isolated standing pose retain source creator attribution; none is a full frame or source-video sequence. Local OFL fonts.
editable: Fonts/palette/seed in project.json; complete choreography, pure-time place particles, field heights, ring, independent phone surfaces, badges, podium, card fan and logo route in composition.js. Source texture provenance/crops in asset-manifest.json.
fidelity: Complete observed sequence rebuilt with differences. The original isometric illustrations are static attributed textures, with independently reconstructed fragment/pose transitions, not recovered rigged characters or original 3D room animation. Actual app source, exact map coordinates/particle field and private imagery are unavailable; visible product statistics are only reference demonstration content and not independently verified.
